intro-to-lvv.question: What is the main purpose of LVV certification?
options: To ensure modified and scratch-built vehicles are safe and legally compliant
To increase the resale value of a vehicle
intro-to-lvv.answer: To ensure modified and scratch-built vehicles are safe and legally compliant

intro-to-lvv.question: Who is responsible for the LVV certification system in New Zealand?
options: The Low Volume Vehicle Technical Association (LVVTA)
intro-to-lvv.answer: The Low Volume Vehicle Technical Association (LVVTA)

lvv-classifications.question: Which of the following is NOT a key consideration for LVV classification?
options: Whether the vehicle is scratch-built or modified
